_comment: Pins a skill's home bundle when it ships in more than one. Without a pin, web/build-skills.mjs gives the skill to the alphabetically last bundle that contains it, so wiring an existing skill into a new bundle would move its catalogue home and its export path (exports/cursor/<bundle>/<skill>/, which search engines index). Add a line here when you wire an existing skill into a new bundle. A pin is ignored if the skill is no longer in that bundle.
